y1: Many people followed Jesus. Jesus went up on a mountain and sat down, and His disciples and the people sat around Him.
y2: Jesus began to speak and teach. These words are called the Sermon on the Mount.
y4: Jesus said amazing words: “Blessed are the poor in spirit. Blessed are those who mourn, for God will comfort them.”
y5: “Blessed are the gentle, the merciful, the pure in heart, and the peacemakers.” God considers weak and humble people very precious.
y6: You are the salt of the world
y7: Jesus said: “You are the salt of the world.”
y8: Salt makes food tasty and keeps it from spoiling. A person who follows Jesus is someone who brings a good flavor among their friends.
y9: You are the light of the world
y10: “You are the light of the world. People do not light a lamp and put it under a bowl, but they put it on a lampstand so it gives light to everyone in the house.”
y11: When we do good deeds, people see them and glorify God. We are little lamps shining Jesus' light.
verse: “You are the salt of the world. … You are the light of the world.”
prayer: Jesus, thank You for Your love that blesses weak and sad people. Thank You for calling me the salt and light of the world. Help me to do good deeds and shine Your light this week. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: mountain. A high place on the earth. Jesus taught on a hill overlooking the Sea of Galilee. Jesus went up on a mountain and sat down.
d1: blessed. A person who receives true joy and good things given by God. Blessed are those who mourn.
d2: gentle. A person with a soft and humble heart who does not get angry easily. Blessed are the gentle.
d3: peace. Stopping fights and living in harmony with each other. Peacemakers will be called children of God.
d4: salt. White grains that give flavor to food and keep it from spoiling. You are the salt of the world.
d5: light. Something that brightens the darkness and shows the way. You are the light of the world.
d6: lampstand. A stand for putting a lamp up high. They put the lamp on a lampstand.
d7: glorify. Praising God for how great and good He is. People glorify God.
